title: Understanding Astrology Planets
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 2 by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Belief and body-mind sync, Jupiter and the child who will not listen, how degrees decide a house, food and planets, the ishta deity, the planets as a household with stones, Kaal Sarp and Q&A.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 2, Understanding Astrology Planets by Brajesh Gautam: belief, degrees and houses, food and planets, ishta deity, stones, Kaal Sarp, with video timestamps.
points: No number is lucky or unlucky.
The chart is about 12 percent fixed. Your belief and body-mind sync is the rest.
Fix Jupiter first for a child who will not listen.
A damaged Jupiter blocks advice. Do not just scold or add tuition.
Check the degrees before trusting a house.
A planet shown in a house may not be working there.
Food and drink are a planet question.
Mars, Moon, Ketu, Rahu and Venus each flag different foods, per the speaker.
Keep your ishta in the west of the home.
One deity per person, no opposing pairs, no ritual needed.
Sun father, Moon mother, Mars son, Mercury daughter, Jupiter guru, Saturn servant.
Do not doubt your guide or curse others.
Doubt and cursing damage the very planet you need.
